steps.action: Identify and isolate the affected host(s) from the network if active compromise is suspected.
Pull full logs for the involved source IP and user account for the surrounding ±30 minute window.
Check threat intel (AbuseIPDB / VirusTotal) for the source IP.
Determine blast radius: which hosts, accounts, and data stores were touched?
Reset credentials for any accounts involved. Revoke active sessions.
Block the offending IP at the perimeter firewall and document the IOCs.
Mark verdict (TP/FP), add analyst notes, and download the PDF incident report.
